FINE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: FINE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the costume

2. Best practice when working on Graphic Design - Typography ● Calligraphy ● Block letters ● Graffiti letters: (1 mark)

   B. Practise Graphic Design - Typography ● Calligraphy ● Block letters ● Graffiti letters with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Fabric decoration: Batik 3.0 Indigenous Crafts 3.1 Pottery 3.2 Sculpture 3.3 Mac: (1 mark)

7. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Collage ● type of collage; single-media and mixed media collage ● characteristic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
